headline: Binance says the hack that froze its withdrawals cost about $6.3B, a blockchain analytics firm links it to North Korea, and bitcoin trades below $78,000 ahead of today's monthly options expiry.

market.asOf: Read about 04:00 UTC Fri 30 Oct (11:00 Bangkok). BTC and SOL from the CoinGecko homepage, ETH from CoinMarketCap's Ethereum page; CoinGecko's own coin pages could not be opened this run. Check the live prices at the top of the page.
market.fearGreed: 37, Fear, on CoinMarketCap's CMC Fear and Greed Index (homepage widget, read after 04:00 UTC). The CoinGecko homepage showed 'Fear (41)' without naming its index. The alternative.me index could not be opened this run.

stories.title: Binance puts its hack at about $6.3B; withdrawals and deposits stay paused
stories.summary: Binance, the world's largest crypto exchange, says preliminary findings put the total impact of Thursday's hack at about $6.3B, likely through a compromised DevOps engineer's laptop, with no evidence that a wallet private key leaked. Withdrawals and deposits remain suspended and no reopening time has been given.
points: Estimates differ: Binance about $6.3B; TRM Labs $6.36B at the time of theft; Chainalysis about $5.9B, per CoinDesk; Glassnode about $5.3B, per Investing.com.
TRM Labs says, with high confidence, that North Korea's 'TraderTraitor' hackers are behind it. Binance has not named an attacker and says it is working with authorities.
Binance said at 00:52 UTC that about $3B had been frozen, per FinanceFeeds. TRM counted about 1.77B USDT frozen by Tether and about 825M USDC by Circle. Frozen funds are not yet returned.
Binance says it will cover all losses from its SAFU emergency fund and company money, per CoinDesk. Binance.US says it was not affected, per Hackread.
TRM says most of the funds left in about 20 minutes from 20:05 UTC on 29 Oct, and the attacker still holds about $2.4B in ETH and BTC.

stories.title: Crypto prices slide after the hack, and DeFi lenders hit the brakes
stories.summary: Prices fell across the market overnight as the size of the Binance hack grew. Lending apps froze markets so the attacker could not borrow against stolen coins, and a large batch of bitcoin options expires today.
points: At about 01:19 UTC bitcoin was near $76,937 (down 4.9% in 24 hours) and ether near $2,211 (down 5.7%), per Cointelegraph.
BNB, Binance's own token, was about $693, down 8%, at the same time, per Cointelegraph.
Aave froze its V3 Ethereum markets after the attacker deposited stolen USDT and borrowed about 19,760 ETH, and Kamino paused a market, per Decrypt.
About $10.92B of bitcoin options expire on Deribit at 08:00 UTC today (15:00 Bangkok), with 'max pain' at $78,000, per KuCoin News. Big expiries can make prices jumpy.

sources.label: Decrypt: hack exit ramps through DeFi

stories.title: Coinbase and Strategy results: crypto gains lift profits as bitcoin nears Strategy's cost
stories.summary: Coinbase's profit came mostly from gains on crypto it holds, while its revenue fell from a year ago. Strategy reported a $19.53B profit, and bitcoin is now trading close to the average price Strategy paid for its coins.
points: Coinbase revenue was $1.216B against $1.233B expected and down about 35% from a year ago, per KuCoin News; Investing.com describes revenue of $1.2B as matching forecasts.
Coinbase's net income of $719M was almost all from $715M of unrealized crypto gains, per KuCoin News.
Coinbase earned $2.51 a share against an expected loss of $0.26, per Investing.com.
Strategy held 848,517 BTC at an average cost of about $75,446 each and reported $19.53B of net income, per MarketScreener.

briefs.title: Bank of Japan holds rates at 1.25% and signals more hikes
briefs.summary: The vote was 8-1, with Hajime Takata wanting a hike to 1.5%, per Reuters via Investing.com. Higher Japanese rates can weigh on risk assets worldwide.

briefs.title: Polymarket resumes trading and will repay affected traders
briefs.summary: Polymarket resumed trading after a security incident at a third-party provider, which Reuters reports was the site-monitoring tool DebugBear, and says it will fully reimburse affected traders.

briefs.title: Kalshi raises $1B at a $40B valuation
briefs.summary: The US prediction market raised $1B at a $40B valuation, per CoinDesk's live blog on 29 Oct.

briefs.title: Robinhood's crypto revenue falls 55% from a year ago
briefs.summary: Robinhood reported $1.42B of revenue, slightly below forecasts, and crypto revenue of $120M, per Decrypt.

briefs.title: Bitcoin funds took in money on Wednesday; ether funds lost money
briefs.summary: US spot bitcoin ETFs took in $137.3M on 28 Oct, while ether ETFs saw $21.4M of outflows, per KuCoin News. Thursday's figures were not available this run.

briefs.title: US economy grew 3.4% in the third quarter
briefs.summary: Q3 GDP grew at a 3.4% annualized rate against a 3.2% forecast, per CoinDesk's live blog.

Consensus +40K jobs and 4.2% unemployment; the prior month was +29K and 4.2%, per Trading Economics. The next Fed decision is Wed 9 Dec at 2:00pm ET (02:00 Thu 10 Dec Bangkok), per the Federal Reserve.

breaking.title: Binance expects to start reopening withdrawals within 48 hours; deposits working normally
breaking.summary: Binance's Yi He said deposits are operating normally and withdrawals should start reopening within about 48 hours. Binance puts the hack's impact at about $6.3B, with roughly $3B frozen.
